record.original_question: Let Pn denote the class of polynomials p(z), p(0) = 1, of degree at most n and of positive real part in D. Find Z 2π max |p(eiθ )|2 dθ. p∈Pn 0 (F. Holland)

evidence.quote: Let Pn denote the class of polynomials p(z), p(0) = 1, of degree at most n and of positive real part in D. Find Z 2π max |p(eiθ )|2 dθ. p∈Pn 0 (F. Holland)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disk. For each integer $n\ge 1$, let $\mathcal{P}_n$ be the class of complex polynomials $p(z)$ of degree at most $n$ satisfying
\[
 p(0)=1\quad\text{and}\quad \operatorname{Re} p(z)>0\ \text{for all } z\in\mathbb{D}.
\]
Determine, as a function of $n$, the exact value of
\[
 M_n\;=\;\sup_{p\in\mathcal{P}_n}\,\int_0^{2\pi}\bigl|p(e^{i\theta})\bigr|^2\,d\theta,
\]
and identify the extremal polynomial(s) achieving this supremum.
artifact.category_tag: Extremal polynomials with positive real part
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search for this extremal problem (maximum of the L^2 norm on the unit circle over polynomials of degree at most n with p(0)=1 and positive real part on the disk) did not turn up a published solution or a definitive open-problem confirmation. The status could not be verified from available sources.

status_evidence.title: Constrained L2-approximation by polynomials on subsets
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses constrained L2 extremal problems for polynomials but does not address this specific Carathéodory-class extremal.
status_evidence.claim: No direct solution to the stated problem is given.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics for Lp extremal polynomials on the unit circle
status_evidence.snippet: General Lp extremal polynomials theory; not specific to polynomials of positive real part with p(0)=1.
status_evidence.claim: Does not resolve the F. Holland problem.
